$comment: Negative syntax tests accepted by the grammar. See docs/conformance.md.
variablesInDataBlocks(state) returns variable ranges for four of these
cases. The application must create and display any diagnostics.
Tests fail for unlisted mismatches, stale entries, and unknown case names.

srl-syntax.test_113: An undeclared prefix. Whether `:s` resolves is a question about the prologue, not about the shape of the document.
srl-syntax.test_122: A variable as the object of a ground DATA triple. The grammar accepts it; variablesInDataBlocks() returns its span.
srl-syntax.test_123: A variable as the predicate of a ground DATA triple, as above.
srl-syntax.test_124: A variable as the subject of a ground DATA triple, as above.
srl-syntax.test_126: A variable reifier in a ground DATA triple, as above.
